note: East Bay Regional Park District family campground in the Arroyo Del Valle canyon below Lake Del Valle, south of Livermore. Generators are not allowed, the gates lock at 10 pm, and the campground is prone to flooding (reservations may be cancelled). --Claude
summary: EBRPD camping page, fees page, FAQ and ReserveAmerica (browser) read. $35/$50 + $8 fee confirmed; extra vehicle $8 ($10 from 2027); 150 sites / 21 full hookup; electric 50 (fees+FAQ) vs 30 (park page); max_rig 35 per RA conditions (FAQ says 35-80 ft); year-round (Dec bookable); FCFS after the 48-h cutoff; 15-night max. Phone and RA deep link supplied. Not waterfront kept.

HOOKUPS: amperage conflict. The camping-fees page and FAQ say 50 amp for Del Valle; the Del Valle camping page's fee list says '30 amp electrical hook-up'. Kept 50 because two district pages agree. A reviewer may prefer to snap down to 30.

SITES: max_rig_ft 35 comes from ReserveAmerica's conditions ('RVs and trailers may not exceed 35 feet'). The FAQ says 'Del Valle accommodates 35-80 feet, depending on site', and RA driveways run 32-74 ft. Either way a 23-ft rig fits.
WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' KEPT: the stored evidence stands (loops in the Arroyo Del Valle canyon, lake ~2 km north, riparian woodland between the loops and the wash).

STATUS open. The family campground is open year-round; only the group camps (Nov-Mar/Apr) and the cabins (January) close. RA warns 'this location is prone to flooding and reservations may be cancelled'.
DISCOUNT: Regional Parks Foundation members get $10 off a night Nov-Mar and $5 Apr-Oct, phone bookings only. It is named in the fees note; no discounts key fits it.
